observed_content: Actual downloaded image inspected. A central irregular lumen is enclosed by a continuous strongly corrugated dark-stained ring; outside it lies a substantial circumferential tissue band containing elongated nuclear profiles, a thinner outer dark contour and surrounding fibrous-appearing pink tissue. This observed morphology is consistent with the supplied arterial-wall identification, rather than the rejected cartilage/epithelial candidate.
interpretive_limit: Identifying the prominent inner dark ring as an internal elastic lamina is an anatomical interpretation of the elastin-stained artery image, not a source-provided annotation. The source does not identify a named arterial subtype or label all wall layers.

limits: No calibrated diameter or wall thickness; no physiological lumen shape, live pressure, elasticity measurement, flow speed or arterial subtype inferred. A fixed section cannot establish dynamic behavior; the corrugated lumen is not a physiological diameter measurement.
